Hi here’s my current roster and I have a couple of questions:

1. Is it worth it to prioritize mouchette copies beyond e2?
2. What future banners/characters should I be preparing for to build a good team? (aside from Thais)
3. What teams can I make using my current roster of characters or using standard characters (I haven’t spent much of my standard pulls due to choice paralysis LOL)

Thanks a lot in advance!!

Hello there and welcome aboard <:Saya_yum:1513124263291387975> 

First off : did you find Cheri's handbook ? ( just type /new if you didn't )

About pure cores : you'll eventually want 5 teams ( 19 awakeners minimum ) so you can really indulge in all realms as much as you want. Just remember to grab some wheels as well.

And no, Mouchette beyond E2 is not that relevant *until* you have your 5 teams ready

As for limited banners : all awakeners currently displayed and those coming in tomorrow are great ( although Pontos is more niche in my opinion ).
So unless you aim for a max-optimized team I'd say pull 1 copy for any that catches your eye / synergies with your teams ( you can get 1 extra proto dupe from the store each month ).
You can see how much you like them in hectic train by borrowing from a whale
Saya's wheel is awesome in any team, so it might be worth to get 1 copy of it as well.

I’m currently in Chapter 7-7 and have finally used my first emergency gnosis on story mode while attempting to clear with my Aequor team.

I know I have other strong units that could do the story easier, but I just love Aequor.

For the team I attached, I wish to keep Caecus and Faros, which of my other characters can fill in the last 2 slots while keeping Pure Aequor realm?

Thank you!

Hey there : )

Caecus already does some damage, I'm not sure Aurita is required so you coudl sub her with Celeste ( that free revival gives a very nice safety net ).

As for Nymph, she could indeed work great with Faros but I's say Lily would be even better if you can catch her

More importantly : one single team can only go so far.
As you go further you'll find a need for diversity as boss have their own tweaks and quirks.

Counter, for instance, is rather inefficient against single high-damage enemies.
Thank you! I’ll try and pull on the chaos standard to see if I can nab lily. I’ll go and try out celeste.

Hey there : )

Sanga is great in a shield-based team but she's pretty versatile, really. Still needs a healer though.

Hello, just finished the prologue and I'm wondering which characters I should prioritize getting with the current banners available. A bit overwhelmed and I wanna make sure that I don't regret spending the free pulls. Is the gacha here like a certain other gacha where the banner characters eventually get added to the standard pool?

Many thanks in advance. I started with Jenkin btw.

Hello and welcome aboard ~

In short : all awakeners currently on display and those comming tomorow are great so I say just grab those that catch your eye !
You can give them a try from the record button on the home screen ( last section ) or borrow them from others in events.

That being said, Mouchette is hailed as the most newcommer-friendly damage-dealer. Might be worth checking if she suits you.

Beyound that, you should definitely check Cheri's guide ( just type /new to find it ) for intel on all available awakeners and recommanded builds.

The awakeners that appeared in arc 1 ( faded legacy ) were indeed made available from the standard banner but at a lower rate ( 1/7 ). Thoses from arc 2 ( astral reign ) are not yet available with pure cores but they rerun every few months
Also : you will eventually want 5 teams ( that 19 awakeners ) so maybe don't think too hard on spending pure cores wherever you like
Thank you, guess I'll pull once the new banners are out.  Are the wheels a must pull or should I go for more characters than wheels?
Word of caution : check when each banner expires. Would be a shame to miss that one unit that works so great for you because you waited for more options : )

Wheels can be game-changers but they are rather easy to get.
Saya's give 1 more aruthmetica which is crazy nice and some others have amazing effects, but overall I'd say units come first
